roadmap.title: Story with full sync
roadmap.description: Play Sequences 1-12 and meet every optional objective in each main mission; Reload Checkpoint lets you retry a failed objective.

roadmap.title: Homestead, ship and early trinkets
roadmap.description: After Sequence 5, recruit settlers, win the Homestead games, start naval work, and craft one invention.

roadmap.title: Clubs, liberation and combat cleanup
roadmap.description: Work the club challenges, liberate a city, and finish the combat achievements by replaying the listed memories.

roadmap.title: Completionist and the Encyclopedia
roadmap.description: Finish every progress tracker entry, then the Encyclopedia of the Common Man last.

achievements.description: Complete 100% of all main mission constraints.
achievements.summary: Get full synchronization on every main mission in @loc{Sequences 1-12}.

guide.context: All optional objectives of a mission must be met in a single run of that mission.

steps.text: Meet every optional objective in each main mission; side missions do not count.
When a red failure notice appears, pause and pick @mechanic{Reload Checkpoint}, not Restart Memory, then try the objective again.
Replay any mission you missed through the @mechanic{DNA Tracker} tab of the pause screen.

achievements.description: Complete the Encyclopedia of the Common Man.
achievements.summary: Record every activity of every settler for the @mechanic{Encyclopedia of the Common Man}.

guide.context: Do this after every settler has arrived on the Homestead and after your other achievements. Hold the scan button on a settler for a few seconds while they do the activity. Settlers stop working at night, when their stockpile is full, or during an active conversation; riding to a city and back resets them.

achievements.description: Craft one of Franklin's inventions to decorate your Manor.
achievements.summary: Craft one of @npc{Benjamin Franklin}'s inventions to decorate the Manor.

guide.context: Crafting needs an artisan who can make the item; finishing Homestead Missions levels your artisans.

steps.text: Collect all four pages of one @item{Almanac} to unlock its invention recipe.
Gather the materials, then open the logbook in the Manor or any General Store.
Choose @mechanic{Crafting}, then @mechanic{Inventions}, and craft one.

achievements.description: Recruit any of the Artisans and see them settled on the Homestead.
achievements.summary: Recruit one artisan and settle them on the Homestead.

steps.text: Finish @loc{River Rescue} in @loc{Sequence 5}.
Take a @mechanic{Homestead Mission} marked by a house icon, such as saving the woodworker @npc{Lance} from the people harassing him on the cliff above the Manor.

achievements.description: See all the optional characters settled at the Homestead.
achievements.summary: Settle every optional character at the Homestead.

guide.context: Look for house icons near the Homestead on the map.

steps.text: Finish each optional character's first @mechanic{Homestead Mission}; their other side quests are not needed.
Recruit the blacksmith in the Frontier and the doctor in Boston during the farmers' third side mission.

achievements.description: Win a game of Fanorona, Morris and Bowls on the Homestead.
achievements.summary: Win a game of Fanorona, a game of Morris, and a game of Bowls at the Homestead.

guide.context: Wins in missions, on the ship in @loc{Sequence 1}, or at the harbor do not count.

steps.text: Finish the lumberers' Level 3 Homestead Mission, which introduces Bowls.
Start each game yourself, outside any mission: Fanorona in the Manor with @npc{Achilles}, Morris in the Inn, Bowls outside the Inn.
Win each one without betting money.

achievements.description: Explore Fort Wolcott.
achievements.summary: Explore @loc{Fort Wolcott}.

steps.text: Finish @loc{The Hard Way} in @loc{Sequence 5}.
Collect one @item{Peg Leg Trinket} and bring it to @npc{Peg Leg} on the Homestead pier.
Start the Fort Wolcott mission and finish it.

achievements.description: Uncover the mystery of Oak Island.
achievements.summary: Finish the @loc{Oak Island} mission and find @npc{Captain Kidd}'s treasure.

guide.context: A Trinkets Map from any General Store costs £3000 and marks every @item{Peg Leg Trinket}. Trinkets in New York are only reachable after @loc{Sequence 8}.

steps.text: Find all 24 @item{Peg Leg Trinkets} and bring them to @npc{Peg Leg} on the Homestead pier.
Finish the four earlier Peg Leg missions.
Sail to @loc{Oak Island}, finish the main objectives, and find the treasure.

achievements.description: Complete all Naval Missions aboard the Aquila.
achievements.summary: Finish all four Naval Missions on the @item{Aquila}.

guide.context: Naval Missions open after the @item{Aquila} mission in @loc{Sequence 5}.

steps.text: Talk to a Harbormaster (anchor icon).
Play the four missions in this order: The Chase, The Rescue, French Involvement, then Biddle's Hideout.

achievements.description: Complete all 12 Privateer Contracts.
achievements.summary: Finish all 12 Privateer Contracts.

steps.text: Take Privateer Contracts from a Harbormaster.
Three contracts open in @loc{Sequence 6}. Three more open in each of @loc{Sequence 7}, @loc{Sequence 8}, and @loc{Sequence 9}.

achievements.description: Upgrade the Aquila.
achievements.summary: Buy any upgrade for the @item{Aquila}.

steps.text: Open the upgrade book beside the Harbormaster and buy one; the cheapest is Extra Cannon for £2500.

achievements.description: Be invited to join a Club.
achievements.summary: Receive an invitation to join a Club.

steps.text: Play on; the Hunting Society invite follows the first cougar kill and skinning at the start of @loc{Sequence 5}.
For another club: beat an enemy with only your fists for the Boston Brawlers, or pickpocket £100 for the Thieves Club.

achievements.description: Complete all challenges for any of the Clubs.
achievements.summary: Finish every challenge and side mission of one Club.

guide.context: Frontiersmen tier 2 asks you to hear all of @npc{Washington}'s talks in New York. Talks you hear before tier 2 opens may not count. If that happens, reload @loc{Missing Supplies} in @loc{Sequence 9}, talk to him twice, finish it, then talk to him again in New York.

steps.text: Open the @mechanic{DNA Progress Tracker} and read the club's current challenges.
Finish each tier in order, then the club's side missions. The Thieves Club has no side missions.

achievements.description: Liberate all districts in Boston OR New York.
achievements.summary: Liberate every district of Boston or New York and finish that city's final Liberation Mission.

steps.text: Finish the Liberation Missions in a district: six in each Boston district and West New York, nine in North and East New York.
Meet the district's contact and finish the assassination mission to liberate it.
After all three districts are free, finish the city-wide final Liberation Mission.

achievements.description: Send a convoy to Boston, New York and the Frontier.
achievements.summary: Send convoy goods to three General Stores: one in Boston, one in New York, one in the Frontier.

steps.text: Get to New York in @loc{Sequence 8}, then discover a General Store in every area.
Open the Accounting Book at the Homestead, then the trade menu.
Send one item to a store in each of the three areas, and confirm.

achievements.description: Retrieve every page for one of Ben Franklin's Almanacs.
achievements.summary: Collect all four pages of one @item{Almanac}.

guide.context: A page you lose comes back after a while.

steps.text: Buy a district map at a General Store to mark the pages in Boston or New York.
Chase down all four pages in one district; they fly away when you get close.

achievements.description: Complete ALL progress tracker grid entries.
achievements.summary: Reach 100% on the progress tracker.

guide.context: Check the @mechanic{Animus DNA Tracker} in the pause menu. It must show 17070 of 17070.

steps.text: Get full sync on all main, Homestead, Naval, Privateer, Liberation, and Peg Leg missions, plus the Courier Missions and the three epilogue missions.
Take over all seven Templar forts by defeating the captain, destroying the powder stores, and raising your own flag.
Finish all Assassination Contracts, Delivery Requests, and the challenges and missions of every Club.
Collect every @item{Almanac} page, every Frontier @item{Feather}, every @item{Peg Leg Trinket}, and open every treasure chest outside Peg Leg missions.
Craft all nine @npc{Franklin} inventions, buy every @item{Aquila} upgrade, and raise all six recruits to Assassin rank.
Buy every weapon from a General Store (£72,554 in total) and open every underground fast travel point in Boston and New York.

achievements.description: Complete 50% of the Progress Tracker entries.
achievements.summary: Reach 50% of the progress tracker.

steps.text: Keep finishing missions and collectibles until the @mechanic{DNA Tracker} shows 8535 of 17070.

achievements.description: Perform a double assassination using a musket.
achievements.summary: Assassinate two enemies at once in melee while holding a loaded musket.

guide.context: Shooting does not count. Make sure the musket is loaded.

steps.text: Pick up a loaded musket from a weapon stand or a guard.
Line up two guards standing next to each other and assassinate them in melee.

achievements.description: Kill 15 guards with a single cannon shot.
achievements.summary: Kill 15 guards with one cannon shot.

steps.text: Replay @loc{The Battle of Monmouth} in @loc{Sequence 10} from the @mechanic{DNA Tracker}.
Right at the start, point the cannon a little left and aim it at the farthest part of the approaching soldiers, then fire.
If it misses, reload the checkpoint.

achievements.description: Hang 5 enemies by using rope darts.
achievements.summary: Hang five enemies with the rope dart.

steps.text: Buy a @item{Rope Dart} at any General Store.
Stand on a tree branch or beam above an enemy and throw the dart while pulling the stick down.
Repeat five times; the second memory of @loc{Sequence 6} works well for this.

achievements.description: Loot a convoy without killing any of its guards.
achievements.summary: Loot a convoy and leave every guard alive.

guide.context: If a guard dies, or you throw a guard into something or kick a downed one, that convoy is ruined. Find another; if none appears, leave the map and return.

steps.text: Find a Frontier convoy, such as the one in front of the south-west Templar fort.
Unequip every weapon and fight with fists only, using plain strikes.
Loot the back of the carriage.

achievements.displayName: Whit's fur ye'll no go by ye!
achievements.description: Block a firing line 5 times by using a human shield.
achievements.summary: Block a musket firing line with a human shield five times.

steps.text: When enemies form a firing line, grab a nearby enemy as a shield.
Repeat five times; reload the checkpoint in the fifth memory of @loc{Sequence 2} to retry.

achievements.description: After becoming fully Notorious, kill 10 Jagers before losing your notoriety.
achievements.summary: After reaching full notoriety, kill 10 Jagers before the notoriety drops.

steps.text: Replay @loc{A Trip to Boston} in @loc{Sequence 5}; climb to the rooftop for full notoriety.
Counter a Jager's attack, then use the break-defense move and finish them.
Stay notorious until 10 are dead.

achievements.description: Have a Trainee reach the Assassin Rank.
achievements.summary: Raise one recruit to Assassin rank.

guide.context: A failed mission only locks that recruit out for five minutes.

steps.text: Recruit a trainee through the Boston or New York liberations.
Send recruits on missions from the Assassin menu until one reaches Rank 11.

achievements.description: Exchange undamaged pelts at all different general stores.
achievements.summary: Sell one undamaged pelt at each of the nine General Stores.

guide.context: Only Hidden Blade kills or snares give undamaged pelts; a pistol damages them. The game does not track which stores you used.

achievements.description: Witness a predator killing an enemy.
achievements.summary: Watch a predator kill an enemy without interfering.

guide.context: Bears, bobcats, cougars and wolves count. If you are seen, the animal attacks you instead.

steps.text: Go to the Packanack hunting zone in the west Frontier, follow the road to the red restricted area, and climb the hill to the west.
Stay out of the fight and do not shoot the bobcats until a hunter dies.
If it fails, die to reset everyone and try again.

achievements.description: Complete each of the epilogue missions unlocked after the credits roll.
achievements.summary: Finish all three epilogue missions after the credits.

steps.text: Sit through the credits, then watch the short epilogue scenes in each area.
